title: ProGen generates artificial proteins with enzyme activity
summary: A protein language model generated synthetic lysozymes: two of the five characterized in cells degraded bacterial cell walls with activity comparable to egg-white lysozyme. Laboratory tests and crystallography support the result, but do not demonstrate clinical applications. The preprint dates to July 18, 2021; the Nature Biotechnology publication and UCSF announcement are from January 2023.

evidence.tested: Five model-generated lysozyme families were experimentally characterised, with activity and catalytic efficiency compared with natural lysozymes, and crystal structures reported.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the abstract read.
evidence.ai_role: Protein language model trained on over 280 million sequences generated artificial lysozymes.
